date.pdf: Use 'Statement End' date from the header (not Statement Start or document date)
date.csv: Use the last date found in the 'Transaction Date' or 'Date' column

amount.csv: Use the final 'Outstanding Balance' value from the last row

tag.pdf: For salary invoices (single employee, Document # matches INV-25-XXXXX): extract the 'Employee Name' field from the PDF and use the employee's FIRST NAME only (lowercase) as the tag. Known employees: Abhishek Kumar Chaurasiya -> abhishek, Suprith Hatikal -> suprith, Utkarsh Yadav -> utkarsh, Anirudh Maheshwari -> anirudh. For commission/EOR invoices (Document # matches INV-COM-25-XXXXX, lists multiple employees): use 'eor' as the tag.

metadata.description: Entity lookup table for finance file renaming. Entities are added incrementally as documents are processed.

schema.name: string - Short canonical name with no spaces (e.g., 'Deel', 'ReevesSnyder')
schema.aliases: array - Alternative names to match in documents (e.g., ['ACME CORPORATION', 'Acme Inc'])
schema.tags: object|null - Tag definitions with keyword arrays, or null if no tags
schema.rules: object|null - Entity-specific extraction rules that override defaults. Keys: 'date', 'amount', 'invoice'. Values can be strings or objects with file-type-specific rules (pdf, csv, xlsx, etc.)
